irrigate.name: Run irrigation
irrigate.description: Run the lawn irrigation cycle across one or more zones.

water_level_sensor.name: Water level sensor
water_level_sensor.description: Entity ID of the sensor reporting current water level.

water_level_min.name: Minimum water level
water_level_min.description: Stop irrigating when the water level drops to this value.

zone_duration_max_sec.name: Per-zone safety cap (seconds)
zone_duration_max_sec.description: Maximum time to run any single zone. Defaults to 600 seconds.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: List of zones to irrigate. Each zone requires entity_id (valve switch) and moisture_sensor.
